description: [DREAL OCCITANIE] Système de traitement des eaux usées (STEU) - station sur le bassin Adour-Garonne et en Occitanie is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.picto-occitanie.fr. Wastewater treatment plants (sewage treatment plants or STEPs) are treatment systems considered "as all sewage treatment works by various processes: biological, physico-chemical..., located on a continuous and homogeneous geographical space. They are urban or industrial according to the nature of their contracting authority.’. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "[DREAL OCCITANIA] Wastewater Treatment System (STEU), station on the Adour-Garonne basin and in Occitania" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2022-01-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
